items.title: New invoice dialog

items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.title: Page header

items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.title: Profile form

items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: app-stats

items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: app-team-table
items.title: Team table

items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.title: Workspace settings

items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge

items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Vertical or horizontal bars in plain SVG, single or grouped series, with titled axes, values at the bar ends, optional textures, keyboard stepping and the data as a table.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-book-intro
items.title: Bible book intro
items.description: The top of a book's page: its name, its own KJV title, a description, the facts and a link to chapter 1.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-book-list
items.title: Bible book list
items.description: A Bible's table of contents: both testaments side by side, each book under its section with its number of chapters.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-chapter-grid
items.title: Bible chapter grid
items.description: Every chapter of a book as a grid of numbered squares, large enough to tap, with the current one marked.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-chapter-pager
items.title: Bible chapter pager
items.description: Previous and next chapter links that cross book boundaries, with ← and → as shortcuts that stay out of the way of controls.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-chapter
items.title: Bible chapter
items.description: One chapter set for reading: raised verse numbers that link to each verse, paragraphs or a verse per line, italics for supplied words, psalm titles, all following the reader settings without a flash.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-header
items.title: Bible header
items.description: The reader's top bar: name, links to the books and search with the current one marked, and a search box that folds into the menu on phones.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-jump
items.title: Bible jump
items.description: Go to any chapter with a book select grouped by testament, a chapter select and a Go button.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-lib
items.title: Bible helpers
items.description: Types and helpers the Bible blocks share: books and chapters, verse references and links, books grouped by testament and section.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-reader-settings
items.title: Bible reader settings
items.description: A popover of display settings for the reader (text size, typeface, paragraphs or verse per line, verse numbers) that apply at once through data attributes on the page.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-search-form
items.title: Bible search form
items.description: A GET search form for words, phrases or a reference, which works without script and fetches results in place with it.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: bible-search-results
items.title: Bible search results
items.description: Full-text search over the Bible and its results: counts per testament and per book, matches marked in each verse, references recognised, pages of 50.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-article
items.title: Article
items.description: A whole post in one article: header, text in Prose with self-linking headings, code blocks with copy buttons, figures, footnotes, and a table of contents.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-footer
items.title: Blog footer
items.description: The bottom of a personal site: name, a line about it, gray links to writing, about, feed and email, and the small print.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-header
items.title: Blog header
items.description: A personal site's top bar: the author's name, Home, Writing and About with the current section in bold (posts and tag pages count as Writing), and the RSS feed.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-intro
items.title: Blog intro
items.description: The top of a personal home page: a greeting as the h1, a paragraph or two, a portrait and a row of contact buttons.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-layout
items.title: Blog layout
items.description: The frame of a personal site (skip link, header, one main landmark, footer) plus a page header, titled sections and a main column with a side column.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-now
items.title: Now box
items.description: A "now" box: what the author is up to at the moment, with the date it was last true, in a Panel.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-post-footer
items.title: Post footer
items.description: After a post: a reply-by-email box with the subject filled in, and the older and newer posts side by side.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-post-header
items.title: Post header
items.description: The head of a post: breadcrumb, title as h1, standfirst, and date, reading time and tags as time elements and links.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-post-list
items.title: Post list
items.description: Posts newest first with date, title link, summary, reading time and tags; or the whole archive grouped under a heading per year.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-profile
items.title: Profile
items.description: The top of an About page: a drawn portrait in theme colours, name and role, the bio, and where else to find the author as a description list.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-projects
items.title: Projects
items.description: Side projects, one per row: name as a link, a status badge (active, maintained, archived), a sentence and small print.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-tags
items.title: Tag links
items.description: Every tag as a link with its post count, in chip-like boxes at control height; the current tag filled.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: blog-toc
items.title: Table of contents
items.description: A post's sections as links: a side-column list that marks the section being read as you scroll, or a collapsible box for phones.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where the page sits in a hierarchy, with long trails folding into a “…” button and links drawn by your router's link component if you like.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: budget-app
items.title: Budget app
items.description: The whole budget page: headline figures, the editable sheet with its save bar, and a monthly chart and category summary that follow every edit.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: budget-category-summary
items.title: Category summary
items.description: The budget per category against last year, with the change in euros and per cent and each category's months as a sparkline.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: budget-data
items.title: Budget data
items.description: The demo budget (a design team's 2027 line items with last year's spend) and the sums the budget blocks show: per line, per month and per category.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: budget-month-chart
items.title: Spend per month
items.description: Planned spend per month as grouped columns, approved lines beside those still waiting, drawn from the lines so it follows the sheet.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: budget-sheet
items.title: Budget sheet
items.description: The year's budget as an editable table: line items with category and owner, an amount per month, the worked-out total, last year and the change, approval and notes, with a totals row.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: budget-stats
items.title: Budget figures
items.description: The plan's headline figures: the total against last year, what waits for approval, the busiest month with a sparkline, and the monthly average.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Buttons on the shared height scale in seven variants (default, primary, secondary, outline, destructive, ghost, link), with icons, loading state, icon-only buttons and button groups.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range, or showing what happens when: the ARIA date grid keyboard, several months, week numbers, limits and unavailable days, and a large size with room for content.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A square bordered box for one piece of content, with header, title, description, action, content and a ruled-off footer.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chart-data-table
items.title: Chart data table
items.description: The numbers behind a chart as a plain table, hidden for screen readers or under a Data disclosure, so no value is only in a picture.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chart-scale
items.title: Chart scale
items.description: Tick math (round numbers, wall-clock times) and the series styles (colour, dash, marker by slot) the charts share.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-app
items.title: Chat app
items.description: A working chat with language models through OpenRouter: conversations kept in the browser, a model picker, streamed Markdown answers, Stop, Regenerate and Edit. Installs the route that holds the key, too.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: The box a message is written in: grows as you type, Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a line, tools on the left, and a send button that turns into Stop in place.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-conversations
items.title: Conversations
items.description: Conversations as sidebar sections, newest first under Today, Yesterday and older headings, with the dialogs that rename and delete one.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-data
items.title: Chat data
items.description: The chat blocks' message and conversation types, the demo's conversations (a long showcase that uses everything the chat draws, and fourteen short ones), starting prompts, and the helpers that title, group and explain them.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Markdown from a model, drawn as it streams in: Streamdown restyled through its component map, with Prose type, the library's tables and links, highlighted code with Copy, KaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams in the theme's colours.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Message
items.description: One message: a question in a gray box on the right, or an answer in Markdown under its model's name, with reasoning, notes for stopped or cut-off answers, and Copy, Regenerate and Edit.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-model-picker
items.title: Model picker
items.description: A native select of the allowed models, grouped into fast and stronger ones, with each one's price per million tokens beside it.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-models
items.title: Chat models
items.description: The models the chat may use, with their prices, and the limits on a request: the allow-list the route checks against.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: The model's reasoning folded into a native <details>: “Thinking…” with a spinner while it streams, “Thought for 4 s” after, the text as a muted aside.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-route
items.title: Chat route
items.description: The route handler at app/api/chat: reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY on the server, lets through only the allowed models, caps messages, input and answer length, and streams the answer with reasoning and metadata.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Thread
items.description: A conversation that scrolls on its own: it follows a streaming answer until you scroll up, then offers Jump to latest; prompts when empty, failures with Retry, and status in a live region.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A square checkbox, drawn the same in every browser, in the main colour with a clickable label, a description and an indeterminate state; a control tall, so it sits level with buttons. CheckboxBox is the box alone, for table rows.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A filter token at control height: a toggle, a removable value, or a plain label.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Pick one option from a long list by typing to filter it, following the ARIA combobox pattern, on the shared height scale and wired to Field.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A command palette: a search box over a filtered, grouped list of commands with icons and shortcuts, inline or in a modal opened with ⌘K or Ctrl+K. Keyboard as the ARIA combobox pattern says.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-app
items.title: Edit conflicts app
items.description: All the edit-conflict prototypes on one page: four approaches for a text box and five for a rich text document, in tabs, each with its scenarios and both screens, and tables comparing them.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-data
items.title: Edit conflicts data
items.description: The pretend collaboration world behind the prototypes: a server with numbered versions that refuses saves based on old ones, two clients each following one approach's policy, presence, a network that can be slow or cut, scripted edits, and the invented ticket and checklist.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-doc-compare-dialog
items.title: Document: compare dialog
items.description: When a document's save is refused: a full-screen dialog with the base, their version and yours side by side for each changed block, a choice per block (preset where only one changed it), and the result rendered underneath.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-doc-field
items.title: Synced editor
items.description: The rich text editor bound to a simulated collaborator from the outside: your caret kept on your words when text arrives, other people's carets, selections and “is editing” marks over it, plus the block views the document prototypes share.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-doc-history
items.title: Document: version history
items.description: Live editing with the version history beside it as a safety net: saves grouped by person, any version compared with now, and Restore, which is itself a new version.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-doc-inline-conflicts
items.title: Document: inline conflict blocks
items.description: A document that merges by paragraphs (and words within one), saying where; a real clash shows in place as both versions stacked, tagged by author, with Keep mine, Keep theirs, Keep both or Edit.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-doc-live-presence
items.title: Document: live presence
items.description: The rich text editor with everyone's carets and selections in their colours with names, “is editing” marks beside paragraphs, and changes flowing in a few times a second while your caret stays put.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-doc-offline-review
items.title: Document: offline review list
items.description: Offline-first editing: on reconnecting, everything that merges is synced at once and a report lists each change with who made it (“5 changes synced, 1 needs you”), the clashes stepped through one by one.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-playground
items.title: Conflict playground
items.description: The frame each prototype sits in: the approach's name, fit and trade-offs, Simulate buttons for the scenarios, your screen and Jonas's side by side, a log of saves, refusals and merges; with the synced text box the text box prototypes share.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-textbox-auto-merge
items.title: Text box: automatic merge
items.description: A text box that saves as you type and merges others' changes in by words, keeping your caret: “Merged Jonas's change” with Show and Undo, and only the words you both changed marked inline with a choice.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-textbox-save-conflict
items.title: Text box: conflict on save
items.description: Optimistic concurrency in a plain form: nothing while you type, then a dialog when the server refuses your save, with both versions marked against the one you started from and Keep mine, Use theirs or Edit merged.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-textbox-soft-lock
items.title: Text box: soft lock
items.description: A text box with presence: a ring and “Jonas is typing…” around the field, read-only for you while he has it, Edit anyway, and a blunt Keep mine / Use his when two edits meet regardless.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: conflicts-textbox-warn
items.title: Text box: warn while typing
items.description: A text box saved by hand that hears about other saves at once: “Jonas changed this 20s ago” under the field, See changes with word diffs, and Use theirs, Keep mine or Merge.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu

items.title: Artist sections
items.description: An artist page's parts: popular tracks with play counts, the discography filtered with chips, and the About box.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-artwork
items.title: Generated artwork
items.description: Square cover art drawn from a seed: eight geometric patterns in eighteen palettes, the title in small type or an artist's initials big. Flat SVG, renders on the server.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-collection-header
items.title: Collection header
items.description: The top of an album, playlist or artist page: big cover, kind, title, facts, and the action row with play, shuffle, save or follow, and a menu.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-data
items.title: Music data
items.description: The Music demo's catalogue: twelve invented artists, 25 releases, about 200 tracks, a dozen playlists and the listener's library, with seeded randomness and the formatting helpers (times, counts, dates) the music blocks share.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-library
items.title: Your Library
items.description: Saved playlists, albums and artists with filter chips, four sort orders, and a list or grid view.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-media-card
items.title: Media cards and shelves
items.description: Cards for albums, playlists and artists with a play button over the cover, shelves that scroll sideways, a filling grid, and the wide tiles of "jump back in".
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-nav
items.title: Music navigation
items.description: The music app's sidebar (Home, Search, Your Library, Liked Songs and your playlists with covers, the playing one marked) and the phone's bottom tab bar.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-now-playing
items.title: Now playing
items.description: The big player: a large cover, title and artists, like, a big seek bar, touch-size transport and volume. A full-screen dialog on phones.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-player-bar
items.title: Player bar
items.description: The bar along the bottom of the music app: now playing with like, transport and seek, queue, big player and volume; a mini player with a progress line on phones.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-player-controls
items.title: Player controls
items.description: Shuffle, previous, play/pause, next and a three-way repeat as toggles; a seek bar that follows your drag and seeks on release; mute and volume.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-player-provider
items.title: Player state
items.description: The music player and the listener's library in React context: a simulated clock, queue, shuffle, repeat, volume, likes and saves, the page-wide keyboard shortcuts, and the play and like buttons built on them.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-queue
items.title: Queue
items.description: What plays now and next: the current track, songs added to the queue (removable), and the rest of the album or playlist. In a drawer, or a sheet on phones.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-search
items.title: Music search
items.description: A big search box over browse tiles for genres and moods, a genre's page, and results grouped into a top result, songs, artists, albums and playlists, with the query in the URL.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: music-track-table
items.title: Track table
items.description: Tracks as a table with number, title and artists, album, date added, like, length and a menu (also on right-click). Hover to play, double-click or Enter to play from a row, arrow keys between rows.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: nav
items.title: Navigation helpers
items.description: What the navbar, sidebar and app shell share: the link component type for routers, click handling, and finding the current link from a pathname.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: The bar across the top of a site or app: brand, main links in the text colour with the current one bold, actions, and a Menu panel on phones. Works with any router.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: next-link
items.title: NextLink
items.description: next/link's Link re-exported from a "use client" file, so server components can pass it as linkAs to Navbar, Sidebar, AppShell, Breadcrumb and Pagination.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A number input with square − and + buttons on the shared height scale, arrow-key steps, units and clamping to min and max.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous, page numbers and Next in one even strip, with row range and rows-per-page, as buttons or as real links; on phones it shrinks to “Page 7 of 14”.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: A titled, bordered box with a gray title bar for meta text and small controls, the basic unit of a dashboard; panels side by side line up.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A click-to-open panel attached to a button, for filters, short forms and details: a native popover, so Escape and a click outside close it, with focus moved in and back, an optional title bar and arrow.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: position
items.title: Position
items.description: Places a floating layer next to an anchor (an element or a point): preferred side, flip when it doesn't fit, shift into the viewport, and keep it placed on scroll and resize. No dependencies.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: presence
items.title: Presence
items.description: Who else is here and where: round avatars in each person's colour, a ring and tag around a field someone is in, remote carets and selections over a textarea or HTML text, “is editing” marks beside blocks, and polite, throttled announcements.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A task's progress bar, determinate or indeterminate (still with reduced motion), and a Meter for measurements that warns past a threshold in symbol and words.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Typography for long text and rendered Markdown (headings, lists, tables, code, footnotes, GitHub alerts) in three reading sizes, as one file with no CSS.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice out of a few, all visible: a real fieldset of native radios with a legend, descriptions and an error.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Relative time
items.description: “3h 20m ago” that keeps itself current, hydration-safe: the server sends a fixed UTC date and the browser swaps in the relative text.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels split by handles you drag or move with the keyboard, side by side or stacked, nestable: limits in percent, collapsible panels (Enter or a double-click), and layouts remembered in localStorage.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich text editor
items.description: A Markdown editor in three modes (formatted, raw Markdown, preview) with a keyboard-friendly toolbar, Markdown typing shortcuts, pictures by upload, paste or drop, and paste cleaned down to what Markdown can say. No editor library.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Two to five mutually exclusive views or modes side by side, exactly a button's height, with native radios underneath.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The browser's own select (system picker on phones, type-to-jump), invisible over a label drawn like a button so it lines up with everything else.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A 1px dividing line: a horizontal rule, a labelled rule (“or”), or a vertical line for toolbars.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Sectioned side navigation with icons, counts read out in words, groups that open in place, a rail of icons, and a modal drawer for phones. Works with any router.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Gray placeholder blocks and text lines for content still loading, hidden from screen readers, still with reduced motion.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A native range input redrawn thin, with a formatted value for screen readers, marks, and a control-height box that lines up with buttons.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-app-shell
items.title: Social app frame
items.description: Three columns on wide screens (nav, a 600px page, search with trends and suggestions), one column with a bottom bar and a post button on phones, the compose dialog and toasts.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: Writing a post or a reply: a growing text box with a 280-character count, picture, poll, emoji, schedule and place tools, and Ctrl+Enter to post; also in a dialog, opened from anywhere with useCompose().
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-data
items.title: Social data
items.description: The Social demo's people and posts: about thirty invented accounts, a hundred posts with threads, quotes, polls and pictures, trends and notifications, with the lookups and the time and count formatting the social blocks share.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-explore
items.title: Explore
items.description: A search box over trending topics, popular posts and people to follow, or, with ?q=, the matching posts and people.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-media
items.title: Generated pictures
items.description: Pictures for posts and profile banners generated from a seed (sky, sun, then hills, a skyline or the sea), each post picture with its alt text and an ALT mark.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-nav
items.title: Social navigation
items.description: The microblog's left column (a rail of icons on medium screens) with a big Post button and your account menu, the phone's bottom bar, and the sticky page header.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-notifications
items.title: Notifications
items.description: Notifications in All and Mentions tabs, grouped by day: likes and reposts bundled with an avatar group, follows, and mentions and replies as posts.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-post
items.title: Post
items.description: A post: avatar, name with hover card, handle and time, text with live #tags, @mentions and links, a picture, poll or quoted post, and reply, repost, like, views, bookmark and share, plus a ⋯ menu. Also the post at full size for its own page.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-profile
items.title: Profile
items.description: A profile's header (banner, picture, name, bio with links, place, website, joined, counts, follow or edit) and its Posts, Replies, Media and Likes tabs.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-thread
items.title: Thread
items.description: A post's page: the conversation above it joined by a line, the post at full size with its counts, a reply box, and the replies with their first answers.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: The home timeline: For you and Following tabs that stay at the top, the composer, and the posts.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-trends
items.title: Trends
items.description: What's trending: category, topic linked to a search, and post counts, with a menu to hide each; as a numbered list or a side panel.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: social-user
items.title: People
items.description: A name with the person's profile in a hover card, a follow button that is a toggle, a person row for lists, and the "Who to follow" panel.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A word-sized line or bar chart for stats and table cells, with an accessible name that says the first, last, low and high values; renders on the server.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The turning loading mark a loading Button shows, sized from the text, announced politely, and still with reduced motion.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A headline number with its label and how it moved, said in words and an arrow as well as colour, with a slot for a sparkline; StatGroup lines them up.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A state as coloured words with a symbol, quieter than a badge, for lists and table cells; plus a one-line error box.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting that takes effect immediately, with the state also in words.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Plain HTML tables, styled: bordered cells, a gray header, right-aligned tabular numbers under left-aligned headers, three densities, and a SimpleTable from columns and rows.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs per the ARIA pattern, boxed or plain, with counts, disabled tabs, a strip that scrolls sideways, and a bold selected label that shifts nothing.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: text-link
items.title: Text link
items.description: A link in running text that looks like one, with an external-link mark option, and linkVariants() for your router's link.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text that resizes vertically, with an optional character count.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: theme
items.title: Default theme
items.description: The default plainspoken-ui theme as shadcn/ui CSS variables: white and black, plain HTML grays, classic blue and purple links, Geist, no corner radius. Make your own on the Customize page.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

theme.font-mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short-lived notifications from a toast() call anywhere, with an action such as Undo, timers that pause while you read, and a keyboard shortcut to reach them.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed (aria-pressed) on the shared height scale, with Button's variants and an icon per state, plus single and multiple ToggleGroups.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint on hover or keyboard focus, after a delay and then at once for the next one; it can be hovered and dismissed with Escape (WCAG 1.4.13), and never opens from touch.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: use-element-width
items.title: useElementWidth
items.description: An element's width, kept current with a ResizeObserver, and 0 on the server so charts that wait for it can't cause a hydration mismatch.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Whether a media query matches, kept current as the window changes, with a fixed value on the server so it never causes a hydration mismatch.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: use-stored-state
items.title: useStoredState
items.description: useState remembered in localStorage, hydration-safe and kept in step across components and tabs.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>

items.name: xlsx
items.title: Excel writer
items.description: Writes .xlsx files with no dependencies: a stored ZIP with CRC-32 around the spreadsheet XML, with numbers, dates, a bold frozen header row, column widths and an autofilter.
items.author: plainspoken-ui <https://github.com/nzmisc/plainspoken-ui>
